info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Corporate Current Account Management API
info.description: The Corporate Current Account Management API enables businesses to efficiently manage their corporate banking needs. This API facilitates the creation and setup of corporate current accounts, allowing organizations to streamline their financial operations. Typical consumers include corporate finance teams and banking applications that require account management functionality. Developers can integrate this API to enhance features related to account creation, improve user onboarding, and support financial transactions seamlessly.
